title: Hamiltonian Spectral-Temporal Dissipative Dynamics for Sequential Recommendation
abstract: arXiv:2608.25755v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequential recommendation requires understanding how user preferences evolve over time, yet most existing models treat such evolution as a first order process where the next state depends solely on the current latent representation. Nevertheless, real user behavior often exhibits richer dynamics, including inertia, periodicity, and sudden shifts that cannot be fully captured by these first order assumptions. Motivated by these behavioral characteristics, we reconceptualize sequential recommendation through the lens of second order dynamical systems and introduce the Hamiltonian Spectral Recommender (HSR), which recasts preference evolution as a dissipative Hamiltonian system in a latent phase space of position (stable preference) and momentum (short-term tendency). translated_title: 哈密顿谱-时间耗散动力学用于序列推荐
translated_abstract: 序列推荐需要理解用户偏好如何随时间演变，然而现有的大多数模型将这种演变视为一阶过程，即下一个状态仅依赖于当前的潜在表示。然而，真实用户行为往往表现出更丰富的动态特性，包括惯性、周期性和突变，这些无法被一阶假设完全捕捉。受这些行为特征启发，我们将序列推荐重新概念化为二阶动力系统，并引入哈密顿谱推荐器（HSR），它将偏好演变重塑为潜在相空间中的耗散哈密顿系统，其中位置代表稳定偏好，动量代表短期倾向。控制方程的线性时不变结构允许在频域中获得闭式解。一个可学习的耗散机制进一步捕捉自然衰减和调整。
tldr: 本文提出HSR模型，通过将序列推荐重构为二阶耗散哈密顿系统，利用频域闭式解和可学习耗散机制，更精准地捕捉用户偏好演变中的惯性、周期性和突变。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the HSR model, which reconceptualizes sequential recommendation as a second-order dissipative Hamiltonian system, leveraging frequency-domain closed-form solutions and a learnable dissipation mechanism to more accurately capture inertia, periodicity, and sudden shifts in user preference evolution.
